payload.exact_statement: For every feasible cell vector x in the baseline model, there is a finite-piece measurable history with each a_ijr in {0,1} and sum_ir a_ijr<=1 for every person, preserving every stream cell integral and every cell-linear target. Partition each person-cell consecutively into stream blocks of lengths x_ijrk and an idle remainder. Conversely these histories are admissible, hence their feasible cell/target sets equal the baseline sets. This requires arbitrary preemption and no minimum-session, switching, synchronisation or extra pointwise constraints; it does not imply integral cell totals.
